Batch 3 contains 412 records. Validation produced 63 violations across 41 records: 28 missing competent units, 17 non-normalized date formats, 11 duplicate identifiers, and 7 statuses not included in the current vocabulary.

Nine warnings concerning the service-delivery channel appear to be false positives. The SHACL shape requires at least one channel, but that field is optional for certain informational procedures. The rule should be made conditional on procedure type rather than removed. Duplicate identifiers require priority review because they affect two different services and could overwrite resources during loading.

Mireia will correct the channel and date rules. Alba will review records without a competent unit. Full validation will be rerun on 22 January. The report must preserve the original results so the effect of the corrections can be compared.
